subject: Request: Horizon Labs - custom uptime tier & order form language
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@horizonlabs.com, jacob.lee@horizonlabs.com
Cc: salesops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Horizon Labs - custom uptime tier & order form language

Hi Amira / Jacob —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Horizon is evaluating a higher-availability commitment for the core ML inference endpoint used by your inference pipelines. To move this forward we need two things from Redwood:

1) Draft SLA addendum (MSA / SOW attachment) that defines an availability tier for the core inference endpoint and a clear credits schedule for missed uptime windows. Horizon would like an initial ask of 99.99% monthly availability and a 95th/99th percentile latency commitment for p95 inference on the 16k sequence workload.

2) Order form language that can be appended to the purchase order (shows service tier, regional routing, and escalation contacts). Procurement prefers explicit terms in the order form rather than buried only in the MSA addendum.

Attached is a spreadsheet (Horizon_SLA_Req.xlsx) with the numbers they asked us to cost out on the call. Can you please:
- Confirm whether 99.99% is feasible for their required traffic profile and region us-west-2
- Provide suggested order form language and the credits schedule we would accept for that tier
- List the operational evidence we can share (uptime reports, latency histograms, SOC 2 artifacts) and any TTLs/retention constraints

If we can turn around a proposed addendum + order form snippet by EOD tomorrow, I will share with Horizon procurement for their internal legal review.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Attachments: Horizon_SLA_Req.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Amira Patel <procurement@horizonlabs.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jacob.lee@horizonlabs.com
Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Horizon Labs - custom uptime tier & order form language

Marissa —

Thanks for sending — appreciate the quick follow-up. We reviewed the spreadsheet internally and have a few initial redlines and questions before we get to legal. High-level: we want a strong availability guarantee, but our standard procurement bar for enterprise inference is 99.95% with explicit regional failover commitments. Below are Horizon's initial asks (we attached a marked-up doc):

- Availability: Horizon prefers 99.95% monthly as a baseline; 99.99% will require financial trade-offs. Please provide a delta pricing estimate for both tiers.
- Credits schedule: We want a clear, stepwise credit schedule (e.g., <99.95% = 5% credit, <99.9% = 10%, <99.75% = 25%). Please confirm Redwood's standard schedule or provide an alternative.
- Latency: Provide p95 and p99 guidance for 16k tokens under dedicated capacity. Also specify whether the latency commitment is for cold-start requests or steady-state with caching enabled.
- Evidence / Audit: We will need monthly uptime reports (CSV), a sample latency histogram for past 90 days from an equivalent workload, and a statement of alignment with SOC 2 controls around availability.
- Region & routing: We require a contractual commitment that user data associated with Horizon production endpoints routing to us-west-2 will not be processed outside the US without prior notice.

I'm attaching a Word doc with inline comments: HL_Redlines_SLA.docx.

If you can send back a proposed addendum and order form language with a recommended credits table and evidence pack, procurement will route to legal.

Best —
Amira Patel
Head of Procurement | Horizon Labs
procurement@horizonlabs.com
Attachment: HL_Redlines_SLA.docx (redlines)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: salesops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Horizon Labs - custom uptime tier & order form language

Karthik / Vanessa —

Forwarding Horizon's redlines and initial asks. They pushed back to 99.95% as the preferred baseline but asked us for delta pricing to support 99.99%. Can you please:

- Karthik: Draft a concise order form snippet + SLA addendum language we can give procurement (1 page prefered) that contains: availability definition, credits schedule (stepwise), latency targets p95/p99, regional processing clause, and the escalation path. Keep language negotiable but not open-ended. Put the suggested credits table inline.

- Vanessa: Pull together an evidence pack we can share (sample uptime CSV, latency histogram for a comparable customer, SOC 2 availability control statement). Note any redaction or NDA constraints for sharing logs. Ops will need 24–48 hours to assemble if we commit. Please confirm whether runbooks or playbooks are shareable in redacted form.

We want to turn around a response to Amira by EOD today (Horizon is aiming to close the procurement PO next week). If we need legal for any unusual wording, flag it inline.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa / Vanessa —

Thanks — below is a concise proposal we can send to Horizon for their procurement/legal review. Vanessa, I noted the Ops evidence items we will attach. Please confirm and I'll incorporate any redline from legal before we send.

--- Proposed SLA addendum (summary snippet for order form) ---
Service Tier: Enterprise High-Availability (Optional upgrade)
Availability Commitment: 99.95% monthly (standard). Optional uplift: 99.99% monthly (additional fee per order form).
Measurement Method: Availability is measured as total successful request seconds divided by total observed request seconds for the provisioned production endpoint over the measurement month, excluding scheduled maintenance windows (72 hours annual cap) and customer-directed maintenance.
Credits Schedule (monthly):
- >= 99.95%: 0% credit
- >= 99.90% and < 99.95%: 5% credit of monthly service fees
- >= 99.75% and < 99.90%: 10% credit of monthly service fees
- < 99.75%: 25% credit of monthly service fees
Latency Commitment (p95/p99 for 16k sequence workload on Dedicated capacity):
- p95: <= 320ms
- p99: <= 960ms
Notes: Latency commitments apply to steady-state requests where KV/prefix caching is enabled; cold-start requests (container or model reload) are excluded.
Regional Processing: Customer data for production endpoints designated to us-west-2 will be processed in-region. Redwood will not route production inference traffic outside the US without prior written notice.
Escalation & Contacts: Provided in order form (Tier 1 ops contact + escalation to Dedicated Capacity SRE).
Evidence Pack (to be delivered monthly on request):
- Monthly uptime CSV (timestamp, success_seconds, total_seconds)
- 90-day latency histogram (p50/p95/p99) for comparable workload
- SOC 2 availability control statement and summary of maintenance windows

Attachments to send: proposed-orderform-sla-snippet.txt (this language), ops-evidence-pack.zip (sample CSV + histograms + SOC statement).

Next steps:
1) Vanessa to confirm Ops can produce redacted uptime CSV and 90-day latency histogram within 48 hours; indicate any NDA gating.
2) Legal to review the credits schedule and regional processing sentence; I'll incorporate.
3) Marissa to send to Amira with the attachments and a short implementation timeline.

If Horizon holds firm on 99.99% without a material price delta, we should push back: 99.99% requires reserved Dedicated capacity plus cross-region redundancy and an uplift. I can draft a short pricing note if you want.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Solutions Architecture, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
